data.name: FindBetterQualityBooksViewModel_ThisToolWillScanYourLiberated
data.value:
This tool will scan your liberated audiobooks to see if Audible has a higher quality version available.
For each liberated audiobook in your library, it will try to read the existing audio file to determine its codec and bitrate. If no local file is found, it will use the 'Last Downloaded' format information stored in the database.
It will then query Audible's API to get the highest quality format currently available for that audiobook.
If you check the 'Use Widevine' option, it will query for Widevine-protected formats, which may or may not be xHE-AAC. If unchecked, it will query for Audible DRM-protected formats, which are typically AAC-LC.
Click 'Scan Audible for Higher Quality Audio' to begin.
When done, click 'Mark X books as Download Pending' to allow Libation to re-download those books in the higher quality format.
Marking books will automatically configure Widevine and xHE-AAC settings and prompt for a fresh account sign-in if needed, ensuring the upgraded audio streams are downloaded.
Note: If you have a large library, downloading many higher-quality audiobooks in quick succession may trigger Audible's daily download limits. You can configure a daily download limit or download delay in Settings > Network if needed.
Display this help message again in the future?

data.name: WalkthroughMessages_AddYourAudibleAccountSThen
data.value:
Add your Audible account(s), then save.
Most accounts use email and a normal region. If yours is a pre-Amazon username login, choose a pre-amazon locale and enter that username.

data.name: WalkthroughMessages_ControlHowAudioFilesAreDecrypted
data.value:
Control how audio files are decrypted, including audio format and metadata handling.
If you choose to split your audiobook into multiple files by chapter marker, you may edit the chapter file 'Naming Template' to control how each chapter file is named.

If you experience a problem and need help, you'll be asked to provide your log file. In certain circumstances we may need you to reproduce the error with a higher level of logging detail.

data.name: WalkthroughMessages_YouReNowReadyToBegin
data.value:
You're now ready to begin using Libation.
One thing worth knowing: Audible keeps a separate library for each marketplace. If you have ever changed your Amazon address to another country to buy a title, it lives in that country's library and a normal scan will not find it. Settings > Accounts > Marketplaces checks the other marketplaces for you.
Enjoy!
